title: An American, six Ukrainians and a Myanmar training case

scenes.title: An American, six Ukrainians and a Myanmar training case
scenes.say: An American and six Ukrainians, accused of training armed groups in Myanmar. Here's where India's case stands.

scenes.title: Matthew VanDyke returned to Delhi on 23 October
scenes.say: On 23 October, US national Matthew VanDyke flew back to Delhi and asked a court to return belongings the NIA had seized.
scenes.speak: On the twenty-third of October, US national Matthew VanDyke flew back to Delhi and asked a court to return belongings the NIA had seized.

scenes.title: From India's Northeast into Myanmar
scenes.say: The NIA arrested the seven in March. VanDyke was detained at Kolkata airport on 13 March, three Ukrainians at Delhi airport the same day.
scenes.speak: The NIA arrested the seven in March. VanDyke was detained at Kolkata airport on the thirteenth of March, three Ukrainians at Delhi airport the same day.

scenes.title: A drone-training trip
scenes.say: The agency alleges they entered Mizoram without permits, crossed into Myanmar to train ethnic armed groups in drone warfare, and returned around 5 March.
scenes.speak: The agency alleges they entered Mizoram without permits, crossed into Myanmar to train ethnic armed groups in drone warfare, and returned around the fifth of March.

scenes.label: The charge-sheet deadline. It came on the last day, without terror charges
scenes.say: It was registered as a terror case. But the charge sheet came on day 180, the deadline, and it did not invoke the anti-terror law.
scenes.speak: It was registered as a terror case. But the charge sheet came on day one hundred and eighty, the deadline, and it did not invoke the anti-terror law.

scenes.title: Immigration, not terror
items: Immigration and Foreigners Act, sections 21 and 23
scenes.say: Instead, they face immigration charges: illegal entry, stay and movement. That cleared the way for bail in September.

scenes.title: Back in court
scenes.say: On 23 October, VanDyke appeared in person, the Ukrainians by video. The court let all seven stay abroad until 24 February 2027.
scenes.speak: On the twenty-third of October, VanDyke appeared in person, the Ukrainians by video. The court let all seven stay abroad until the twenty-fourth of February, twenty twenty-seven.

scenes.text: Can the agency make its larger conspiracy allegations stand up in court?
scenes.say: The NIA says its probe continues. The question is whether its bigger allegations will stand up in court.
